records.text: Don't ever mess with nature! President DJT

Jon Husted, who was a Great Football Player in College, had Record Setting numbers of interceptions. In fact, he was known as "Interception Jon." I found out when Jon Gruden spoke at our first Ohio Rally. I asked the Coach, "Why are you here Jon?" He said, "I'm here to support my teammate for Senator of Ohio," and I said, "What do you mean, teammate, did Jon Husted play football?" And Jon Gruden said, "Yeah, we had a great team, and he was the best player, by far. He played safety, and he had 17 interceptions, A RECORD!" I said, "Wow, I didn't know that about Jon." He said, "Yep, he was a great player, but because of the man he is, HUMBLE, he doesn't go around talking about it like everyone else would have." Such a great story! OHIO, VOTE FOR JON HUSTED FOR THE U.S. SENATE — HE IS A WINNER, A CHAMPION, AND A GREAT GUY. HE WILL NEVER LET YOU DOWN! President DONALD J. TRUMP

The Houthis are behaving very badly. I thought they learned their lesson a year ago when we bombed the HELL out of them and, at their request, stopped. They've been silent for a long time, but now they've emerged again, probably at the behest of Iran, which is a Failing Nation, with No Navy, No Airforce, the World's Worst Economy, and 301% Inflation, in a very nasty way, hitting Saudi Arabia, and purposefully trying to drive up Oil Prices, probably prior to the U.S. Elections — NOT NICE. Somebody should explain to them that I'm not running in the Elections, I've already won, IN A MASSIVE LANDSLIDE, but I'll be there after the Elections, and I will never forget! President DONALD J. TRUMP

Happy Birthday to the United States Navy! It is now 251 years of Victories, Old and New. What they've done with the impenetrable Steel Wall (Sometimes referred to as the Blockade) in the Hormuz Strait is another Historic Achievement, one of many. HAPPY BIRTHDAY U.S. NAVY! President DONALD J. TRUMP

I see so many comments from the Radical Left Morons and Lunatics that China and Russia are helping the "wonderful" Islamic Republic of Iran. If they are, it's at a very low level, but I don't believe they are at all. They have too much to lose, and we would know about it, and know about it very fast! Thank you for your attention to this matter. President DONALD J. TRUMP
